posts.name: SHUBHAM CHAKRABORTY
posts.cooked: I am enrolled in Data Science and for practice I am doing the vmt_1.. tasks now the question is many question are different like use of bc,c, github and many types of different question now Should i try these , if not what should i practice then. @hemalatha @sayan

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked:
Usually questions on the VM are grouped by a category and in each such category there exist multiple questions. For example questions whose names are of type practice_8.* are practice questions for concepts taught till week 8 (sed). Your vmt questions are the same.

If you’re finding the vmt questions a bit challenging, I’d recommend to start off with all practice questions in the VM first. Once you’re covered most of them try solving all oppe-practice- questions and then move onto solving vmt or q- questions.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
If you want to practice for OPPE, hold off doing vmt questions for now, as qs pertaining to github will not be there in OPPE. Plus, its level is a bit higher. Do vmt ones after you have done all of the vm questions.

Questions to practice for OPPE -

  • ppa
  • practice
  • q-grep, q-sed, q-awk
  • oppe-practice
